title: 正文 第十章 外忧内患
content_zh:
“绝壁隘口怎么会爆发这么强的战斗。”他身材孔武有力，脸颊线条分明，使人感觉到一种刚毅的美。走动起来，龙行虎步，气若泰山，如虬龙般的肌肉充满着爆炸性的力量。

    “武坤师哥，苍岚师弟和乐萱师妹还没有来到此地集合，我很担心他们。绝壁隘口是来万物塔的必经之路，不如我们去看看，万一出了事，也好有个补救措施。”说话者名为林雅，她身材高挑，举止端庄。一颦一笑间流露出一种说不出的风韵，美而不艳，一度引起众多人的推崇，其中就包括徐辉。

    “此事交由我处理就行，你暂且留在这里，万一战斗起来，我一个人行事也比较方便些。”武坤说完便离开了他们暂时建立的落脚点。

    “小心。”看着离去的师兄，林雅担忧，在这里完全要靠自己。不同于外界，有师门做坚强的后盾。

    武坤离开万物塔，一路风驰电掣，赶向绝壁隘口。路途中遇见一位与他抱有相同目的的人，他是天剑宗的剑辰。

    感应到如此庞大的战斗波动还敢出来的人，皆非凡俗，他们都是同境界的奇才，全力以赴下都可以发出超越当前境界的力量。

    他们相互对望了一眼，并未说话，眼神里都透着忌惮，不到万不得已，他们都不希望与彼此战斗。

    两人大步流星，一前一后进入绝壁隘口，听到隘口深处传来的战斗声。二人徒然加势，速度再提三分。

    绝壁隘口笔直，而修者目力又远超常人。一进隘口，二人都看见远方的战斗，也看见了他们要找的人。

    “一人一个。”看着岌岌可危的几人，二人暂时达成了同盟。

    “人剑合一。”剑辰大呵，整个人瞬间变得犀利。化为一抹寒光，超越了肉身极限，迸发而去，直接消失了身影。

    “师妹，对不起，我不该带你来。”陆典悲伤，他已经没有了丝毫的力气，唯一能做的就是将王语兰紧紧的抱在怀里。只要他还活着，就不能让王语兰先死。

    看着已经抽到他面前的触手，陆典闭上了眼睛。不过想象的疼痛一直没有传来，陆典睁开眼睛一看，一道人形寒光来回穿梭于幽海天章周围。须臾间，庞大的幽海天章便轰然倒地，滩烂泥般的肉体上布满了人腰粗细的洞口。与此同时，他面前出现了一个人，将他和王语兰护在了身后。

    “大师兄。”陆典惊讶，眼神里泛发出一丝光彩。他的这位师兄年龄小于他，他从来没有认真叫过他，因为他不服。

    看着守护他和王语兰的笔直的身影，陆典放下了曾经高傲的头颅。这一刻，他才从心底里认可他的这个大师兄。“原来这就是差距。”

    “这是幽海天章的兽丹，先为自己疗伤，至于什么情况，以后再说。”剑辰拿出一枚鸡蛋大小的兽丹，递给了陆典。这是他刚击杀幽海天章是取出来的。

    与此同时，武坤如同一头人形暴龙，他比剑辰暴力的多。直接拎起霸王蟹的一只腿，就是一顿猛摔。片刻间石壁便被他毁坏的一塌糊涂。霸王蟹也被抽成了一堆烂泥。看着苍岚的样子，他的心都些颤抖。可以说，苍岚是他带大的，在他眼里，苍岚就是他的亲弟弟。

    “不要说话，固守心神。”武坤直接来到苍岚背后，将自己最为精纯的生命精气渡给了苍岚。直到苍岚的伤势停止恶化。

    “师哥……上面还有一人，如若不是他，我们早死了！”苍受伤太重，晓是有武坤给他输送生命精气，仍是很虚弱，有些摇摇欲坠。

    “放心，这里交给我，苍岚口中的人，不仅救了你的人，也救我的人。这是恩，务必将他救下来。”剑辰性子有些孤傲，不愿意欠他人的情。

    武坤点头，脚踏虚空而行。片刻后回到了几人面前，手里拿着半截龟裂的鳞翼，轻轻一捏鳞翼化为了粉末，看着飘散的粉末，武坤摇了摇头。

    “对不起，幻兄。”如若不是为我，你怎么会死去，甚至连尸骨都未曾留下，苍岚大悲，气急攻心，晕了过去。

    “这……这怎么可能。”徐辉几人不愿意相信，虽说和幻天认识不长，但相处下来甚是投机，如今得知他死去，几人情绪非常低落。

    “武坤兄，这次来的遗落之地，处处透着诡异，和往年记载大不相同。我想这其中必有阴谋。”剑辰看着周围狼藉的地面说道。

    “反常必有妖，若是到了关键时刻，我们结为同盟如何。”武坤敏锐的感觉到，这还只是开始，接下来将是更大的难关。

    “好。”剑辰同意。

    “此地不宜久留，休息十分钟后，马上回万物塔的临时基地。”武坤建议。

    听武坤说完，受伤的几人拿出疗伤药液，为自己修复伤势。修复完伤势后，武坤和剑辰带领着几人回到了万物塔附近的临时基地。等回到基地，几人才发现，不知何时，少了一个人。

    “死流氓，占了姑奶奶的便宜就想跑。我才不相信你死了。”石心月从一道石缝中走出来，小巧玲珑的身体上沾满了灰尘。
content_en:
"How could such a fierce battle break out at the cliff pass?" He has a powerful figure and clear cheek lines, which makes people feel a kind of resolute beauty. When he moves around, he moves like a dragon and a tiger, with energy as strong as Mount Tai, and his muscles like a horned dragon are full of explosive power.

    "Senior Brother Wu Kun, Junior Brother Cang Lan and Junior Sister Le Xuan haven't gathered here yet. I'm worried about them. The cliff pass is the only way to get to the Tower of All Things. Why don't we go take a look and find a remedy if something goes wrong." The speaker's name is Lin Ya. She is tall and has a dignified manner. There is an indescribable charm between every frown and smile, which is beautiful but not flashy. It once attracted the admiration of many people, including Xu Hui.

    "Just leave this matter to me. You stay here for the time being. If a fight breaks out, it will be more convenient for me to act alone." After Wu Kun finished speaking, he left the temporary foothold they had established.

    "Be careful." Looking at the senior brother leaving, Lin Ya was worried. She had to rely entirely on herself here. Unlike the outside world, there is a strong backing from the master.

    Wu Kun left the Tower of All Things and rushed towards the cliff pass at lightning speed. On the way, he met someone who had the same purpose as him. He was Jian Chen of Tianjian Sect.

    Those who dare to come out after sensing such a huge battle fluctuation are all extraordinary. They are all prodigies of the same realm. They can exert power beyond their current realm with all their strength.

    They looked at each other without speaking, their eyes were full of fear, and they didn't want to fight each other unless they had to.

    The two of them strode into the cliff pass one after another, and heard the sound of fighting coming from the depths of the pass. The two of them increased their momentum in vain and increased their speed by another three points.

    The cliff pass is straight, and the practitioner's eyesight is far beyond that of ordinary people. Once they entered the pass, they both saw the battle in the distance and the person they were looking for.

    "One for each." Looking at the people in danger, the two temporarily formed an alliance.

    "The man and the sword become one." Jian Chen yelled, and his whole body became sharp in an instant. It turned into a wisp of cold light, surpassed the limits of the physical body, burst out, and disappeared directly.

    "Junior sister, I'm sorry, I shouldn't have brought you here." Lu Dian was sad. He had no strength at all. The only thing he could do was to hug Wang Yulan tightly in his arms. As long as he is still alive, Wang Yulan cannot be allowed to die first.

    Looking at the tentacle that had been drawn in front of him, Lu Dian closed his eyes. However, the imagined pain never came. Lu Dian opened his eyes and saw a human-shaped cold light traveling back and forth around Youhai Tianzhang. In an instant, the huge Youhai Tianzhang collapsed to the ground, and its mud-like body was covered with holes as thick as a human waist. At the same time, a person appeared in front of him, protecting him and Wang Yulan behind him.

    "Elder brother." Lu Dian was surprised, with a gleam in his eyes. His senior brother was younger than him, and he never called him seriously because he refused to accept it.

    Looking at the upright figure guarding him and Wang Yulan, Lu Dian lowered his once proud head. At this moment, he recognized his senior brother from the bottom of his heart. “It turns out that’s the gap.”

    "This is the beast elixir from Youhai Tianzhang. Heal yourself first. As for the situation, we will talk about it later." Jian Chen took out an egg-sized beast elixir and handed it to Lu Dian. This was taken out just after he killed Youhai Tianzhang.

    At the same time, Wu Kun was like a humanoid tyrannosaurus, he was much more violent than Jian Chen. He directly picked up one of the king crab's legs and threw it violently. In a matter of seconds, the stone wall was completely destroyed by him. The king crab was also smoked into a pile of mud. Looking at Cang Lan's appearance, his heart trembled. It can be said that Cang Lan was brought up by him. In his eyes, Cang Lan is his biological brother.

    "Don't talk, just keep your mind." Wu Kun came directly behind Cang Lan and transferred his purest life essence to Cang Lan. Until Cang Lan's injury stopped worsening.

    "Brother... there is another person above. If it weren't for him, we would have died long ago!" Cang was too seriously injured, and Xiao was still very weak and a little shaky even though Wu Kun was delivering life essence to him.

    "Don't worry, leave this place to me. The person Cang Lan talks about not only saved your people, but also my people. This is a favor. You must save him." Jian Chen has a somewhat aloof temper and does not want to owe others.

    Wu Kun nodded and walked on the void. After a while, he returned to several people. He held half of the cracked scale wing in his hand. He gently pinched the scale wing and turned it into powder. Looking at the scattered powder, Wu Kun shook his head.

    "I'm sorry, Brother Huan." If it wasn't for me, how could you have died? You didn't even leave any bones behind. Cang Lan was so sad that she was so angry that she fainted.

    "This... how is this possible?" Xu Hui and others did not want to believe it. Although they had not known Huantian for a long time, they had become very close to each other. Now that they learned that he was dead, they were very depressed.

    "Brother Wu Kun, the Forsaken Land we came to this time is full of weirdness, which is very different from previous records. I think there must be a conspiracy." Jian Chen said while looking at the messy ground around him.

    "Abnormality must be accompanied by monsters. If the critical moment comes, how about we form an alliance." Wu Kun keenly felt that this was just the beginning, and there would be greater difficulties next.

    "Okay." Jian Chen agreed.

    "It's not advisable to stay here for a long time. After ten minutes of rest, return to the temporary base of the Tower of All Things immediately." Wu Kun suggested.

    After listening to Wu Kun's words, the injured people took out healing liquid to repair their injuries. After repairing their injuries, Wu Kun and Jian Chen led several people back to the temporary base near the Tower of All Things. When they returned to the base, they discovered that one person was missing at some point.

    "You damn gangster, you took advantage of my aunt and tried to run away. I don't believe you are dead." Shi Xinyue walked out of a crack in the stone, her small and exquisite body covered with dust.
title_en: Text Chapter 10 External Troubles and Internal Troubles
